comprehend-languages.target-language_hin: What should your target language be
comprehend-languages.iconOnly_hint: If enabled the header button will show with only the icon and no text
comprehend-languages.separate-folder_hin: If enabled the translated documents & items will be put into a separate folder.
comprehend-languages.translate-folder-na: If enabled together with the *Separate Folder* setting, the name of the folder will be translated as well.
comprehend-languages.translate-journal-n: If enabled the names of Journals, Journal Pages and Items will be translated as well and the language prefix omitted.
comprehend-languages.in-place_hint: If enabled the original document will be overwritten with the translated text. The following three settings will be ignored if this is enabled.
comprehend-languages.formality_hint: How formal should the translations be (if the language supports it)
